instruction: A candid street photograph capturing a full-body shot of a young couple walking directly toward the camera on a city crosswalk. In the background, a brick building is decorated with a green holiday wreath and a red bow. On the right, the man in the white puffer jacket and red turtleneck (R1) walks forward, holding a bouquet of red roses in his left hand with his gaze directed downward. On the left, the woman in the pink puffer jacket and white pants (R2) walks alongside him, her right arm affectionately looped through his left arm as she looks slightly to her right with a relaxed expression. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight under an overcast sky, highlighting the vibrant red of the roses and the pink of her jacket.
